messages:
Leah: quick follow-up from the 02:00 UTC postmortem. we need owners for remediation items: headroom plan, scheduler tuning, tenant quota guards, and a recurring audit cadence. keep it tight.
Omar: i'll pick scheduler tuning. short-term: add a per-node small-model slot boost and reduce preemption churn. ETA: PR by 2025-06-08.
Priya: i'll own quota backstops. plan: per-tenant token bucket + emergency throttle route. PR target 2025-06-06.
Leah: i'll draft a headroom proposal (incl cost delta) and routing rules to Dedicated pools. due 2025-06-09.
sre-bot: incident summary: scheduler queue buildup -> headroom starvation; peak GPU util 98%; fallback rate 21%.
Omar: scheduler sketch: feature flag `slot_boost_small_models: true`, cap per-node 8->11. canary 3% traffic for 2h. metrics to watch: `gpu_util`, `scheduler_queue_len`, `preemption_rate`.
Priya: quota example config:
```yaml
per_tenant:
  burst: 300
  refill_per_sec: 30
  max_concurrent: 120
alerts:
  sustained_pct: 70
```
Leah: recurring pattern: headroom erosion every ~21 days linked to long-running batch windows. propose weekly headroom audit in ops rotation.
opsbot: created task #CI-3033 "weekly-headroom-audit" assigned ops-rotation; first run 2025-06-10.
Leah: owners/timelines recap:
- Omar: scheduler slot boost PR + canary plan 92025-06-08
- Priya: quota token-bucket PR + alerting 92025-06-06
- Leah: headroom + routing proposal 92025-06-09
- Ops Rotation (opsbot): weekly headroom audit starting 2025-06-10
Priya: linking PR for quota draft: https://git.internal/r/3890 - review ping @Omar @Leah
Omar: will add smoke test simulating 80% sustained load for 15m to CI and a dashboard panel.
Leah: after PR merges we'll run a 2h verification window for canaries and a 6h soak after full rollout.
Priya: noted and will enable alerts after 24h of merged monitoring.
Leah: i'll put milestone cards on the postmortem board and follow up in tomorrow's sync. reopen here if blockers. :thumbsup:
